verdict: Partly. 3248211 can serve as the base for R7 and the whole-race QA, but N-01 has to be fixed first. The blocker F-01 is really fixed: after the snowy exit Modern shows 2.5–3.1 % pure white against Arcade's 0.1–0.3 % (65–68 % before), it switches in the same frame as Arcade, and there are no brown frames. The gates are green: Arcade golden 20/20 and 17/17, Rule-3 checksums equal to Arcade by day and at night, every related render check and 175 unit tests. N-01 is a small but real regression from the commit that is now spread over frames: the stale-reflector SCRIPT ERROR, reproduced with a probe and not yet seen in a real drive. B-01 and F-08 are not proven fixed: per-frame commit reached 6.51 ms and 4.23 ms because a single builder is never split, and the streamer hitch is still 71.5 ms on this VM (inferred: only the Deck can settle it). F-06 is half done (the Gran Turismo is pixel-identical to before, still silver), and F-02, F-03 and F-04 are untouched, as FIX-RINT announced.

findings.where: scripts/race3d/layers/lights.gd add_reflectors() Z.238-243, _update_glints() Z.562-565; trigger chunk_streamer.gd _commit_step()/_drop()/_make_room()/clear(), builders/roadside.gd Z.395-399
findings.problem: Since B-01 a chunk can be dropped while it is COMMITTING (it never entered the tree), for example through _make_room() with max_chunks full or through clear(). roadside.commit() has already called lights.add_reflectors(mi, list) by then. The lights layer forgets reflectors only on tree_exiting, which never comes for such a node. After _free_trash() frees it, every _update_glints() with the low beam on raises SCRIPT ERROR and aborts, so the reflector glints freeze for the rest of the stage. FIX-RINT guarded _statics and the flares with is_instance_valid, but not _reflectors.
findings.evidence: measured: probe m1/NACH-RINT/sh/probe_reflectors.gd with the real lights.gd. Register a reflector on an out-of-tree node, free the node, call _update_glints 3x -> 3x 'SCRIPT ERROR: Trying to assign invalid previously freed instance. at: _update_glints (lights.gd:563)', and _reflector_count stays 1. Not observed in 3 real threaded drives (KH day and night, Saragossa-Pau night; 0 errors). How often it happens in play is inferred: rarely.
findings.fix: In _update_glints() drop entries whose pair[0] is not is_instance_valid() and lower _reflector_count, as _update_pools() does for _statics; or let the streamer notify the layers when it drops a COMMITTING chunk. Add a unit test: reflector on a node that is never added, free it, update the glints -> no error and a count of 0.
